mostWorthwhile.text: Aerobic ATP renewal was most worthwhile: the planned illustration distinguishes fuel oxidation from oxygen's role and connects the hydrogen-ion gradient to ATP synthase.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the glucose carrier was predictable setup on its own, although the subsequent transport sequence made its changing shape useful.

surprise.text: The aerobic result made the different jobs of fuel and oxygen especially clear, with oxygen receiving electrons and water forming.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but choosing aerobic ATP rather than glycolytic ATP for the pump and protein pathway was not explained as necessary; both were offered as compatible options.

continue.text: I would continue: the contrast between passive sodium entry and powered pumping connected membrane structure to cell regulation, and I would be curious to see how later constructions build on it.
